name: Fulfilment / Delivery
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-024 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ECO-019 CONTAINS WM-ECO-024 and WM-ECO-024 references to WM-FLW-011 and WM-ECO-008 remain candidate ledger edges, not canonical relations.
Boundary hold: fulfilment, order, party, product, inventory, shipment, consignment, package, service execution, entitlement, invoice, payment, return, refund and records retain separate identities.
State-axis hold: commitment, allocation, readiness, dispatch, custody, attempt, handover, receipt, inspection, acceptance, completion, billing and payment states and clocks must not collapse.
Quantity and condition hold: every promised, allocated, dispatched, received, accepted, rejected and outstanding value requires item, unit, lot or serial, method, source, time and uncertainty.
Temporal hold: requested, promised, planned, ready, dispatched, arrived, attempted, handed-over, received, inspected, accepted, completed, observed, ingested and known times remain distinct.
Completion hold: delivered, received, accepted, completed, conforming, paid, discharged and dispute-free require separate evidence and authority.

Authority hold: order acceptance, allocation, dispatch, activation, receipt signature, conformity acceptance, discharge, billing, payment, return, refund, disclosure and disposition require delegated authority.
Jurisdiction hold: CISG and EU consumer and sale-of-goods rules are scoped profiles; national, sector, safety, customs and contract rules need validation.
Interoperability hold: every UBL, UN/EDIFACT, EPCIS, Schema.org, TM Forum, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs version pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Privacy hold: recipient, address, route, access-code, item, serial, condition, tracking, proof and dispute data require purpose-bound access, minimization and retention controls.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
